facts.heading: Anxiety worsened in September
facts.content: Hannah feels anxious all the time, and this feeling got worse in September.
facts.evidence: I think I'm just anxious all the time and it got worse in September.

facts.heading: Became deputy head at school
facts.content: Hannah is a deputy head at her school.
facts.evidence: I was my deputy head at my school.

facts.heading: Taught at school for 11 years
facts.content: Hannah has taught at her school for 11 years.
facts.evidence: I've taught here for 11 years

facts.heading: Worries about being inadequate
facts.content: Hannah worries that people picked the wrong person for her role and that someone will notice her inadequacy.
facts.evidence: I keep thinking they picked the wrong person and that sooner or later someone will notice

facts.heading: Rehearses Monday's meetings
facts.content: Hannah rehearses possible questions and responses for Monday's meetings, especially on Sunday evenings.
facts.evidence: Mostly Sunday evenings my chest goes tight and I start rehearsing Monday's stuff meeting in my head

facts.heading: Fears being seen as incompetent
facts.content: Hannah imagines people thinking she is out of her depth or that she is incapable.
facts.evidence: That I'm out of my depth, that they gave the job to a nice year four teacher who can't actually read.

facts.heading: Rewrote email four times
facts.content: Last week, Hannah rewrote the same email to the governors four times.
facts.evidence: Last week I rewrote the same email to the governors four times.

facts.heading: Afraid of Mr Hargraves' opinion
facts.content: Hannah was afraid that Mr Hargraves, the chair of governors, would think she was stupid regarding the behaviour policy email.
facts.evidence: I was afraid Mr Hargraves, the chair of governors, would think that I was stupid.

facts.heading: Mr Hargraves has been kind
facts.content: Mr Hargraves has been kind to Hannah.
facts.evidence: He has been nothing but kind.

facts.heading: Feels like lying to Mr Hargraves
facts.content: Hannah feels like she is lying to Mr Hargraves about being capable.
facts.evidence: It makes it worse somehow, because I feel like I'm lying to him.

facts.heading: Feels like pretending to be capable
facts.content: Hannah feels like she is pretending to be someone who knows what she is doing.
facts.evidence: Pretending to be what? Uh, somebody who knows what she's doing.

facts.heading: Feels like child in mother's coat
facts.content: Hannah feels like a child wearing her mother's coat.
facts.evidence: Most days I feel like a child wearing her mother's coat.

facts.heading: Mother was head teacher
facts.content: Hannah's mother was a head teacher for 20 years.
facts.evidence: She was a head teacher for 20 years.

facts.heading: Compares self to mother's career
facts.content: Hannah compares her current job to her mother's career, wondering if her mother would have done it better.
facts.evidence: Everything I do, I think, would she have done it better?

facts.heading: Mother is supportive but dismissive
facts.content: Hannah's mother is supportive on the surface but tells Hannah she worries too much and should stop being silly.
facts.evidence: She says I've always worried too much and I should stop being silly.

facts.heading: Waking at four every morning

facts.evidence: I'm awake at four every morning

facts.evidence: Then I'm awake at four going through the to-do list

facts.evidence: Timetable changes, the offset prep, a parent complaint, a child I'm worried about
